positions.title: Senior Software Engineer and Technical Lead
positions.description:
Technical Lead for vertical team responsible for the architecture and implementation of features including Teams, Tags, Device Verification, Two Factor Authentication, and User Account Management.

Technologies used : JavaScript(ES6), Ember.js, Ruby on Rails, Node.js, SaSS, Go, Docker, Concourse, Sentry, Segment, Bower, AWS, Git, Drone, BugCrowd

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architected, developed and shipped “Snooze” to save emails for a later time, group calendar scheduling, shared team email templates and email based call to action buttons.

Technologies used : JavaScript, Meteor, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Backbone, SaSS, Gulp, Git

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technical Lead for Imgur’s mobile website, where I Implemented new sign-in and registration redesigns, subreddit support, introduction of Bower to manage external dependencies, stabilized upload behavior, managed the Android-wrapped version of the mobile site and added a functional test suite.

Led team planning for new mobile web rewrite. Created engineering specs and designed API behavior necessary to implement designs to spec, including working with API and devops engineers. Created open source API integration library, imgur.js, written in ES6 for internal use on our mobile rewrite.

Led architectural design and development of Imgur’s embed unit, including mobile responsiveness as well as extensive browser support and testing on all platforms. Used by BuzzFeed, Washington Post, Elle and many other publications.

Technologies used : JavaScript, Backbone.js, Bower, Grunt, PHP, MySQL, Gulp, Node.js, React, Stylus, ES6, Git

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full stack JavaScript Development. 
Projects: Versal for Organizations, Versal's first billing system, embedded courses 

Technologies used : Javascript, Node.js, Backbone.js, Marionette, Scala, Coffeescript, Stylus, Git

positions.title: YouTube Partner
positions.description:
•	I direct, write, film, and perform in instructional makeup and beauty videos on YouTube.  
•	In of May of 2009, I was selected by Youtube as a “Partner”, which means I generate revenue from my videos through advertisements. As of May, 2021, I have 43.3K subscribers and over 7 million total video views.

volunteerExperiences.description: Mentors work with a Pursuit Fellow over the course of 6 weeks to deepen their understanding of the tech industry and practice advanced technical skills. By the end of this mentorship, Fellows will be better equipped to pass technical interviews at tech companies.

projects.title: DeveloperWeek Hackathon Judge
projects.description: The DeveloperWeek Hackathon is a 30-hour app-building contest in downtown San Francisco - and is also the official kick-off of DeveloperWeek 2014! The purpose of the hackathon is to give developers, designers, and entrepreneurs the chance to pitch app ideas - form teams - build a prototype of their app - and present to our hackathon judges for a chance to be one of the top 3 hackathon winners who get publicity and connections during DeveloperWeek.

projects.title: DeveloperWeek Speaker: PANEL: Software Development: This Is a Man’s World, But it would be nothing without a woman or a girl
projects.description: From Grace Hopper to Jean E. Sammet to Roberta Williams, this industry has seen the world’s most impressive female minds. Yet, we are still struggling to get more women in the field today. In this session, you will meet women developers. Real ones, who have built, refactored, innovated and improved products, projects and businesses worth millions. See and hear who, what, where, why, when and how have women changed the software development world. What is next in the horizon? Agenda: I. Brief introduction to the “History of Women in Computer Science” II. Introduction of Panelists III. Issues in today’s developer landscape that women are primed to solve IV. Q&A
